risk.source: NASA Life Support BVAD, NTRS 20210024855 https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20210024855/downloads/BVAD_2.15.22-final.pdf

risk.title: Orbital debris during refuelling (0 refuel missions, 3 d @7 d cadence, ~340 km)
risk.note: >=3 mm: 4.4e-05 expected (may perforate a 4 mm wall without Whipple shielding — qualitative). Area 399 m^2 (random tumble). Cadence 3/14 d gives x0.43/x2.
risk.source: https://www.hou.usra.edu/meetings/orbitaldebris2019/orbital2019paper/pdf/6065.pdf (ORDEM 3.0, yr 2029)

risk.title: Micrometeoroid impacts in cruise (Grün 1985, r^-1.3)
risk.note: >=1e-4 g: 3.1; >=1e-3 g: 0.18. Beyond ~5 AU the r^-1.3 law is an extrapolation.
risk.source: Grün et al. 1985 Icarus 62:244; constants per NASA MEM 3 (NTRS 20200000563)

risk.title: Asteroid-belt crossing (110 d between 2.1-3.3 AU)
risk.note: Uniform-torus estimate; smaller bodies raise this by orders of magnitude but remain < 1e-6.
risk.source: Tedesco & Desert 2002 AJ 124:2070 (1.2e6 asteroids D>1 km)

risk.title: Neptune ring-plane crossing (periapsis 1.5 R)
risk.note: Rings/dust 1.7-2.54 R: Galle-Adams rings 1.7-2.54 Rn. Crossing location depends on approach geometry (not modelled).
risk.source: NASA planetary ring fact sheets; Voyager/Cassini

risk.title: Comms delay and solar conjunction
risk.note: Round trip up to 512 min. 7 d with Sun-Earth-probe angle <2 deg (typical blackout), 144 d <5 deg (degraded).
risk.source: geometry from DE440s; 2-deg conjunction practice per NASA Mars missions

pareto.note: Expected (mean) one-way crew dose, sheltered 20 g/cm^2 during SPEs; delta-v from LEO incl. capture. Direct points are a 1/3 subsample of the porkchop grid within +3 km/s of its minimum.
